versions.changelog: Initial release - 5 Windows 11 compliance policies, 4 configuration profiles, compliance-to-CA mapping, 8-step rollout order, exception process, KPIs. macOS compliance planned for v1.1.0.

dependencies.description: CA004 (Require Compliant or Hybrid Joined Device for Admins) cannot evaluate any device as compliant without the policies in this pack. Customers owning ca-hardening-pack with CA004 in report-only for 14+ days and without this pack should receive the upsell trigger defined in source/gtm-content.md.
Step 7 of rolloutOrder reuses the same pilot-group and wave-based rollout structure as mfa-rollout-kit. Customers owning both can align pilot groups and wave schedules.

crossSell.upsellTrigger: Customers who purchased ca-hardening-pack and have CA004 in report-only mode for 14+ days without this pack should be prompted with the CA004-readiness message defined in source/gtm-content.md.
